definitions.name: U1D.ARGMAX
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> index of its largest value, the first one when several tie

definitions.name: U1D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES U1D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record with numeric values -> the key holding the largest value, the first such key on a tie

definitions.name: U1D.SPJOIN
definitions.note: Vector of Strings (no whitespace inside) -> one String of them joined by single spaces ('' for empty)

definitions.name: U1D.CAP
definitions.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER W CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty String -> same String with its first character upper-cased, the rest kept

definitions.name: U1D.PRESENT
definitions.note: Vector -> only its non-NIL elements, in order

definitions.name: U1D.RLE
definitions.body: [ [ '' 0 ] ] [ 'X' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 GET [ 'LV' 'LC' ] BIND A -1 DROP LV LC 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT A X 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 LV X EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD 1 DROP
definitions.note: Vector -> run-length encoding: Vector of [ value count ] pairs, one per maximal run of equal adjacent elements (works for numbers, Strings, Booleans)

definitions.name: U1D.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP 1 1 V 0 GET 3 COLLECT [ 'X' BIND [ 'CUR' 'BEST' 'PREV' ] BIND CUR 1 ADD 1 X PREV GT SELECT 'C2' BIND C2 BEST C2 MAX X 3 COLLECT ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> length of the longest stretch of adjacent strictly increasing values (1 for a single value)

definitions.name: U1D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> median (mean of the two middle values when the count is even)

definitions.name: U1D.BYNAME
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Record name to sum of its amounts, names in first-appearance order

definitions.name: U1D.BSIGNS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND -1 1 '([' C SEARCH NIL? SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: String of brackets ( ) [ ] -> Vector of 1 per opening and -1 per closing bracket

definitions.name: U1D.BRED
definitions.note: String of brackets -> same with every adjacent '()' and '[]' pair deleted once (one reduction round)

definitions.name: U1D.BREDUCE
definitions.body: U1D.BRED U1D.BRED U1D.BRED U1D.BRED U1D.BRED U1D.BRED
definitions.note: String of at most 12 brackets -> its normal form after deleting adjacent matched pairs until none remain ('' iff balanced)

solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: CHARS 'V' BIND 0 V LENGTH RANGE [ 'K' BIND K 0 V K TAKE JOIN U1D.BREDUCE '' EQ SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.debtors: U1D.BYNAME 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 0 LT 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'E' BIND E E ZIP 1 GET U1D.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: LOWER G0A.WORDS [ U1D.CAP ] MAP U1D.SPJOIN
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'WS' BIND WS WS [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP U1D.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.majority: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T VALUES 'C' BIND C U1D.ARGMAX 'I' BIND T KEYS I GET 1 COLLECT 0 1 C I GET 2 MUL V LENGTH GT SELECT GET
solutions.sensor.filled: 'V' BIND V U1D.PRESENT 0 GET 'F' BIND V F [ 'X' BIND 'P' BIND P X X NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP U1D.RLE [ 0 GET ] FILTER LENGTH
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ NIL? ] MAP U1D.RLE [ 0 GET ] FILTER [ 1 GET ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'V' BIND V -1 DROP V 1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP [ [ 'A' 'B' ] BIND 1 B B NIL? SELECT 1 A A NIL? SELECT DIV 1 COLLECT 0 1 A NIL? NOT B NIL? NOT AND SELECT GET ] MAP
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'V' BIND V U1D.PRESENT 'P' BIND P P 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND V [ 'X' BIND 1 X X NIL? SELECT M DIV 1 COLLECT 0 1 X NIL? NOT SELECT GET ] MAP
solutions.series.mad: 'V' BIND V V U1D.MEDIAN SUB 'D' BIND D D -1 MUL MAX U1D.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP V 2 DROP ADD ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
